Hightouch (Carry Technologies, Inc. dba Hightouch, California) is a reverse ETL and data activation platform. While marketing references 99.99% global uptime, the public Terms of Service provides no contractual uptime commitment — the sole stated remedy for service defects is "prompt correction." Custom uptime SLAs with credit schedules are available only through Enterprise plan negotiation.
